video_title: Darius Garland's Message to Clippers Fans: Be Patient | Andscape

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on the Clippers' offseason roster changes
quotes.excerpt: it's a lot that happened, but like you said, this too shall pass.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: The saying 'this too shall pass' is that kind of your mentality with what's happened with the Clippers this offseason?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Garland
text_blocks.text: Yeah, for sure. It's a lot that happened, but like you said, this too shall pass. We're really worried about this year. We're staying in the present, we're staying where our feet are right now, so work with the guys we have now, day by day, get better every day.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland on his reaction to Kawhi Leonard's departure
quotes.excerpt: I was definitely kind of surprised actually, but I knew it was probably going to happen.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: When it became official that Kawhi was moved, what was your reaction and when did you start thinking about how that changed things for you?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Garland
text_blocks.text: I was definitely kind of surprised actually, but I knew it was probably going to happen sooner or later. But my mentality hasn't changed at all. When I got traded here last year, they wanted me to come in, be a leader, and be a spark. We could play faster, we could move the ball, push the pace. So my mindset and mentality hasn't changed. It's actually gotten better.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland embracing his role as the face of the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I think I've been through a lot in this career, and I think I'm ready to take on the reins.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: I don't know if you feel this way, I kind of feel like you earned the position to be the face of the franchise now. Is that something that you thought about? Is that something that you want?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Garland
text_blocks.text: It's definitely something that I want. I think I've been through a lot in this career, and I think I'm ready to take on the reins of that. Especially year eight, I think I'm actually found myself a little bit and I know where I want to get to.

quotes.speaker: Tyronn Lue
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue praises Darius Garland's serious approach to the season
quotes.excerpt: As a max player, a guy who's been an All-Star in this league, it's very uncommon.
quotes.quote: The summer Darius had was unbelievable. As a max player, a guy who's been an All-Star in this league, it's very uncommon. So to see him do that this summer, it just showed you his approach to how serious he is about this season.

quotes.speaker: Max Strus
quotes.summary_phrase: Max Strus on Darius Garland's leadership and positive influence
quotes.excerpt: He has the ability to control the whole room and the way he acts, his attitude.
quotes.quote: He has the ability to control the whole room and the way he acts, his attitude, the way he controls himself every single day, people feed off of it and he knows that. He's already taken steps from when I was with him in Cleveland in a positive direction.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Garland's message of patience to Clippers fans
quotes.excerpt: Be patient. It's a lot going on right now, but just worry about what's going on this year.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: What do you tell Clippers fans right now?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Garland
text_blocks.text: Be patient. It's a lot going on right now, but just worry about what's going on this year. We got a lot of new faces coming in, so we definitely have to be patient, got to work through a lot of bumps and bruises, even though we want to win games at a high rate. It's going to happen. It's a long season. Keep better every game, we'll get better every year, and this too shall pass.
